Model checkpoints

Title: ToothSeg

Shankeeth Vinayahalingam

The model checkpoints are downloaded separately on first use. The application
records the DOI, source, checksum, and license in the local model metadata.

Changes made by this project
----------------------------
This project adapts the published two-branch inference and self-correction
workflow for a strict Apple Silicon MPS preview path, including a reduced
semantic MPS patch plan, automatic dental ROI cropping, full-volume labelmap
restoration, progress reporting, and local macOS application integration.

This is an independent, unofficial integration. The original creators and
upstream project do not endorse this application.
